profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit educational organization whose website, at the time of harvesting, returned only a client-side challenge rather than substantive content, so the description of its work and mission comes primarily from held facts rather than scraped site text.

The organization's AI product tracked by this site is Khanmigo, categorized as an educational AI tutor. Held facts note that Khanmigo involves student interaction data and is subject to COPPA compliance considerations, and that pedagogical bias has been flagged as a relevant concern for the product.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are held for Khan Academy. The organization is confirmed as a nonprofit and was verified on this site as of August 24, 2026.
